verdicts.reason: A keeps the terrazzo backdrop, the book and a strong one-line headline. But the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill, the Inkwell & Lantern logo is unreadably small and jammed into a bottom row with the eyebrow and legal text, and the card bleeds off the top and bottom edges. B drops the terrazzo entirely, which costs a lot of brand fidelity. Its '24 HOURS, 24 READERS' eyebrow is blown up to compete with the headline and sits below the body copy, the logo is illegibly tiny next to the legal text, and a dead gap separates the text block, book and CTA, so its fragments are scattered and the order is jumbled.
